Subject: Priority pathway: sequencing MSA/DPA/order form to meet Q3 go-live

Hi Maria / HealthBridge procurement team —

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. Per our discussion, I put together a first-pass mutual action plan that lines up evaluation milestones, legal reviews, and signature gates so we can meet the target go-live of Sept 1. Attached: HealthBridge_MAP_v1.xlsx (timeline + owners).

Key asks from our side:
- Can procurement confirm their internal approval window (estimated days to PO/commit)?
- Can legal flag any must-have DPA/PSA clauses up front so Laura can prioritize review?

High-level target dates:
- Pilot provisioning: conditional on MSA redline agreement — target Aug 20
- MSA + DPA executed & order form signed: target Aug 28

If that timeline is too tight for you, let us know the single biggest blocker and we can propose a reduced-scope rollout.

Thanks — Jordan

Jordan —

Appreciate the MAP and clear ask. High-level response from procurement/legal:
- Procurement can complete an intake review the week of Aug 17, then we need 5 business days to route approvals internally (so earliest PO week of Aug 24).
- Legal is stretched but can do a focused review if you provide a redline bundle (we prefer a single document with tracked changes).

Two constraints to flag: 1) any customer data residency or custom logging language will add time; 2) CISO wants the DPA reviewed in parallel but expects at least 10 business days of turnaround.

I can share internal calendar slots for a contract-working session if Laura wants to jump in — our legal lead is free Aug 12 (afternoon) or Aug 18 (morning).

Also looping in Contracts (contracts@healthbridge.com) who will own DocuSign/PO process.

Best,
Maria Lopez

HealthBridge

Maria / Jordan —

Thanks Maria — helpful constraints. To make the legal sequencing explicit, my proposal:

1) Parallel lanes (recommended):
   - Lane A: MSA redlines & core commercial terms (Laura lead). Target complete: Aug 20.
   - Lane B: DPA review (privacy team). Start immediately in parallel; target complete: Aug 27.

2) Order form: we treat the order form as the final commitment and place it in DocuSign only after MSA + DPA agree-to-sign text is locked. If procurement needs a pre-PO, we can provide a signed letter of intent with pricing to accelerate procurement workflows.

3) Redline package: Jordan — I attached a starting MSA redline (MSA_redlines_Jordan_20260811.docx). Please confirm any non-standard clauses (data residency, attribution, export controls) and I will triage with privacy.

If HealthBridge can confirm availability for a contract working session on Aug 12 (as Maria suggested), Laura + one privacy engineer will attend and we can try to close the first-pass redlines live.

Laura Bennett

- Aug 12: Contract working session (HealthBridge legal + Redwood counsel) — Laura to run (confirmed)
- Aug 17: Procurement intake & initial approval window begins (HealthBridge)
- Aug 20: Target first-pass MSA redline agreement (Lane A)
- Aug 24–28: DPA finalization and internal approvals (Lane B)
- Aug 28: Order form signed & DocuSign complete (target commit)
- Sept 1: Pilot go-live (conditional on order form sign & provisioning)

Immediate asks / owners:
- HealthBridge / Maria: confirm Aug 12 working session time by EOD Aug 11 (owner: Maria).
- Laura: prepare consolidated redline bundle & track critical privacy clauses (owner: Laura).
- Karthik: share one-page pricing summary and SKU map (owner: Karthik).
- Jordan: I will update the MAP spreadsheet with the owner column and circulate a live link after this thread.
